title: Gone Coastal on 30A's Santa Rosa Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts

description_expanded: Gone Coastal is a new home in Santa Rosa Beach that has four bedrooms and four bathrooms, so almost every bedroom has a full bath en suite. It has a great location that is only minutes away from the beautiful white sand beach. Up to 11 happy beach going guests may be accommodated here in this comfortably furnished hospitable South Walton vacation home. The first floor level at Gone Coastal includes a main open living area that is open to the dining room and the modern kitchen. Rich milk chocolate toned hardwood-flooring flows throughout providing a warm homey feel. Woven straw accent rugs provide a tropical look in the living and dining area. Decorative arts and prints feature sea life for wonderful colorful beach flair. A dove gray couch and accent chairs provide a cozy seating ensemble facing a wall mounted TV for entertainment. The charming dining room area has a round table with a unique tree trunk type base and six crisscross backed chairs. Nearby the bright white kitchen has a bar with four stools for additional diners. It also provides a great spot to set out savory seafood snacks and favorite tropical drinks. Stainless steel appliances give you everything you need to create a fun family feast on those evenings when you decide to dine in. The four bedrooms are all individually decorated but all share a distinct golden nostalgic cottage style. One of them is on the first floor level with access to a full bathroom that doubles as a convenient powder room. A back staircase leads up to the other three. The Primary Bedroom and one of the other Guest Bedrooms feature a king sized bed and a full bath en suite. The Primary Bedroom also has its own private balcony that sits above the small covered open porch at the front door. The other Guest Bedroom has a queen sized bed with carved pineapple topped posts while a Bunk Room at the top of the stairs has a sliding barn door entrance with a two sets of bunk beds perfect for the kids. Besides close access to the sugary dune that has a ramp leading down to the shimmering shore this South Walton location is also sits nearby Gulf Place, which serves as the unofficial town center of Santa Rosa Beach. There is a large grassy lawn that is used for outdoor musical concerts and seasonal festivals throughout the year. There is an assortment of friendly restaurants, little bistros, patio cafes, specialty boutiques and art galleries. Free summer concerts are held every Sunday afternoon from 5:00 till 8:00 pm up until Labor Day Weekend. The third Thursday of each month from March through December there is a Wine Walk About. This location also acts a gateway to Scenic 30A with picturesque coastal villages towards the east and abundant amusements at Baytowne Wharf as well as Grand Boulevard at Sandestin towards the west. First Floor: Living Room, Kitchen, Dining, King Bedroom with Full Bath and Walk-In Shower,  Powder Room, Laundry. Second Floor: King Primary Suite with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, Queen Bedroom with Full Bath and Tub/Shower Combo, Bunk Room with Full/Twin Bunk + Twin Bunk and Walk-In Shower.
